correctness.rationale: On the stated 12-vertex edge list, an independent exhaustive enumeration of induced component sizes at r=1,2,3,4 obtained the frozen face vectors, nonempty counts 126, 424, 728, 1175 and Euler characteristics 2, 0, 0, −63. A fresh relative collapse removes 152 distinct elementary pairs in the full current Ind_3, with each proposed free simplex having its paired simplex as its only proper coface; it preserves all of Ind_2 and reaches exactly that 424-face target. The independent 211-pair Morse matching on Ind_2 has critical dimensions 0 and 3, with acyclicity checked on all 1428 cover incidences. The matched finite complex has the homotopy type of a CW complex with one 0-cell and one 3-cell attached to that point, hence S^3 without any field restriction. The Euler obstructions are to the two specified adjoining inclusions. The frozen source, verification note and code were inspected, not executed. Replay using branches/d9f64756-c4a1-4585-86e9-1090990070b5/record2_independent_recompute.py; record2_independent_recompute.out in that directory includes the 152 face-mask pairs. The integral conclusion rests on collapse and Morse theory, not on the frozen mod-two check.
